subject: Greenline vendor intake pause — proposed alternatives and reschedule
messages:
From: Elaine Holt <elaine.holt@greenline.com>

Cc: procurement@greenline.com
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo request

Hi Vivek / Kimberly,

Thanks for the outreach — we reviewed the intro materials and procurement/security require a few gating items before we can run a live technical demo with our engineers. Specifically:

- SOC 2 Type II report (or attestation) + penetration test summary
- Completed vendor portal questionnaire (link below)
- Signed MSA or at least redlines submitted for legal review
- SSO/SAML integration details for test account provisioning

Our security lead (Maria) is traveling the week of May 10–16, which means we won't be able to get the intake sign-off for a live demo during that window. Procurement has asked that we pause scheduling until the portal intake is complete. Apologies for the delay — if you can upload the documents listed above and complete the questionnaire, we'll prioritize slots the week of June 7.

Vendor portal: https://vendor-portal.greenline.com/portal/form/GL-57

If you want to share a recorded demo or a short executive briefing for stakeholders while intake proceeds, we can accept that as a temporary step.

Regards,
Elaine Holt
Senior Procurement Manager
Greenline Financial

Subject: Re: Redwood demo request

Hi Elaine — thanks for the quick clarity and the portal link. Totally understand the travel constraint and procurement gating.

We can do the following to keep momentum:
1) I will upload a SOC 2 summary and our most recent pen-test digest to the portal today.
2) We can provide a short recorded technical walkthrough (15–20 minutes) aimed at your security and infra folks while Maria is traveling.
3) If Greenline is open, we can give scoped sandbox access to one or two Greenline engineers for basic evaluation (no customer data).

I've attached a one-page checklist and our SOC2 summary for your intake team. If procurement can accept these as prelims, we'd like to tentatively target the week of June 7 for a live walkthrough.

Attachments:
- vendor-intake-checklist.pdf (PDF, 47KB)
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Let me know if a recorded session helps in the interim — happy to set that up this week.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni

From: Maria Alves <maria.alves@greenline.com>

Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo request — intake items

Vivek — thanks for the checklist and SOC summary. A couple of clarifications from security before we commit to any live session:

Required for intake (short list):
- Full SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) or completed SOC attestation letter
- Vendor questionnaire answered in the portal (link) — please ensure each question has a concise answer and links to supporting docs
- SAML metadata and example test user provisioning steps
- Data Processing Addendum (DPA) or statement of processing + insurance certificate (cyber liability)

We can accept a recorded walkthrough in the interim, but our engineering leads will still want either sandbox access or a technical call after Maria returns (after May 16). Procurement has indicated open demo capacity beginning June 7; the earliest concrete slots we'd consider are June 9–11.

If you can upload the SOC2 report and draft DPA, I will fast-track legal review where possible.

Thanks,
Maria Alves
Information Security Lead
Greenline Financial

Team — forwarding Greenline's intake answers. They want SOC2 and a DPA prior to a live demo; Maria is out next week so earliest live slots look like June 9–11. Also note they prefer sandbox access for engineer evaluation.

Proposed plan:
- Offer a short recorded technical walkthrough this week for stakeholders (Vivek to record).
- Provide sandbox access (one-week scoped environment) to two Greenline engineers the week of May 24 so they can poke around without requiring a live session. Ops to coordinate ephemeral creds.
- Prepare a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) mapping intake items to deliverables and target dates; propose June 9 10:00 AM ET for the live demo (contingent on SOC2 / DPA progress).

Kim — can you confirm we can stand up a limited sandbox for May 24 and whether Legal can move on the DPA draft? Sean — can you own the MAP spreadsheet and the sandbox access notes? I'll draft the recorded walkthrough and share by EOD.

Thanks,
Vivek
